If The Premises are damaged or destroyed by any of the Insured Risks and have not been re-installed so as to make them fit for occupation and use within a period of three years from the date of such damage or destruction than either the Tenant or Landlord shall be entitled to determine this Lease at any time (but not once the Premises have been re-instated) by serving written notice on the other party to that effect where upon this Lease shall determine but without prejudice to the rights of either party against the other In respect of any antecedent breach.

The Landlord covenants with the Tenant to maintain, retain, and replace the landscaped areas shown hatched black on the plan annexed hereto until such time as the Landlord serves written notice on the Tenant terminating such obligation whereupon such obligation shall revert to the Tenant.
